title: Invisible Monsters
author: Chuck Palahniuk
summary: A fashion model whose face was destroyed by a gunshot is left unable to speak. She travels with a flamboyant drag queen named Brandy Alexander, and the story is told out of order and keeps revising itself.
readIf: you like Palahniuk's transgressive, darkly comic style and fractured structure.
skipIf: you dislike shock, bleak humour or non-linear narratives.
